instruction: Compare iPhone 14 Pro with iPhone 13 Pro and iPhone 12 Pro

metadata.explanation: Variation comparing iPhone Pro models (non-Max) using the same Apple comparison interface. The agent needs to navigate to the iPhone comparison page and select the three specified models: iPhone 14 Pro, iPhone 13 Pro, and iPhone 12 Pro. Uses existing evaluator that parses the modelList parameter from the active tab URL.
metadata.verification: The expected modelList values match Apple's URL parameter format for iPhone Pro models. Similar to the original iPhone comparison task, maintaining similar complexity and interaction pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction by checking if the active tab URL contains the three specified iPhone Pro model parameters
Complete coverage: instruction requires comparing three specific iPhone models, and evaluator checks for exactly those three models in the URL modelList parameter
Getter logic is correct: get_active_tab_url_parse extracts URL parameters using urlparse/parse_qs, handles split_list option to convert comma-separated values to list
Metric logic is correct: check_direct_json_object compares result with expected values, ignore_list_order=true properly handles model order independence
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts modelList → splits by comma → returns list; metric compares with expected list (order-independent)
Expected values are semantically correct: iphone-14-pro, iphone-13-pro, iphone-12-pro match Apple URL parameter format
Practical feasibility: getter can access active tab URL via accessibility tree, URL parsing logic is robust with error handling
